talentInfo.title: Frozen Wastes
talentInfo.description: Frozen Tempest Mana cost reduced by 2 per second.  Quest: Damage enemy Heroes with Frozen Tempest.  Reward: After damaging enemy Heroes 150 times with Frozen Tempest, the Movement and Attack Speed Slows of Frozen Tempest last an extra 1.5 seconds against enemy Heroes.

talentInfo.title: Shattered Armor
talentInfo.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Howling Blast have their Armor reduced by 15 for 4 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Immortal Coil
talentInfo.description: Gain the healing effect of Death Coil even when used on enemies. If Death Coil is used on Arthas, it heals for an additional 75% bonus healing and its cooldown is reduced by 3 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Army of the Dead
talentInfo.description: Consume all charges to summon an equal number of Ghouls that lose Health over 20 seconds and attack for 20 (+4% per level) damage. Reactivate to sacrifice a ghoul, healing Arthas for 240 (+4% per level) Health. Stores up to 6 charges.  Whenever a nearby enemy Minion dies, reduce the charge cooldown of this Ability by 1 second. Takedowns reduce the charge cooldown of this Ability by 6 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Summon Sindragosa
talentInfo.description: Deals 230 (+4% per level) damage and Slows enemies by 60% for 4 seconds. Also disables Minions, Mercenaries, Monsters and Structures for 20 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Biting Cold
talentInfo.description: Each second an enemy is damaged by Frozen Tempest, it deals 15% bonus damage, up to a 75% bonus.

talentInfo.title: Deathlord
talentInfo.description: If Death Coil is used on an enemy Hero, launch an additional Death Coil at a nearby enemy Hero.  Passive: Death Coil deals more damage the lower Arthas's current Health is, up to a maximum of 50% bonus damage.

talentInfo.title: Remorseless Winter
talentInfo.description: Enemy Heroes that remain within Frozen Tempest for 2.5 seconds are Rooted for 1.25 seconds and heal Arthas for 3% of his maximum Health. This effect has an 8 second cooldown per target.

talentInfo.title: Embrace Death
talentInfo.description: Death Coil deals more damage and heals more the lower Arthas's current Health is, to a maximum of 100% bonus damage and healing.

talentInfo.title: Legion of Northrend
talentInfo.description: Reduce Army of the Dead's charge cooldown by 5 seconds.  Each charge consumed spawns an additional Ghoul to attack nearby enemies. These Ghouls cannot be sacrificed.

talentInfo.title: Absolute Zero
talentInfo.description: Sindragosa flies twice as far. Enemy Heroes are Rooted for 2.5 seconds, and then Slowed by 60% for 4 seconds.

level_four.title: Frozen Wastes
level_four.description: Frozen Tempest Mana cost reduced by 2 per second.  Quest: Damage enemy Heroes with Frozen Tempest.  Reward: After damaging enemy Heroes 150 times with Frozen Tempest, the Movement and Attack Speed Slows of Frozen Tempest last an extra 1.5 seconds against enemy Heroes.

level_seven.title: Immortal Coil
level_seven.description: Gain the healing effect of Death Coil even when used on enemies. If Death Coil is used on Arthas, it heals for an additional 75% bonus healing and its cooldown is reduced by 3 seconds.

level_ten.title: Army of the Dead
level_ten.description: Consume all charges to summon an equal number of Ghouls that lose Health over 20 seconds and attack for 20 (+4% per level) damage. Reactivate to sacrifice a ghoul, healing Arthas for 240 (+4% per level) Health. Stores up to 6 charges.  Whenever a nearby enemy Minion dies, reduce the charge cooldown of this Ability by 1 second. Takedowns reduce the charge cooldown of this Ability by 6 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Biting Cold
level_thirteen.description: Each second an enemy is damaged by Frozen Tempest, it deals 15% bonus damage, up to a 75% bonus.

level_sixteen.title: Remorseless Winter
level_sixteen.description: Enemy Heroes that remain within Frozen Tempest for 2.5 seconds are Rooted for 1.25 seconds and heal Arthas for 3% of his maximum Health. This effect has an 8 second cooldown per target.

level_twenty.title: Legion of Northrend
level_twenty.description: Reduce Army of the Dead's charge cooldown by 5 seconds.  Each charge consumed spawns an additional Ghoul to attack nearby enemies. These Ghouls cannot be sacrificed.

level_four.title: Deathlord
level_four.description: If Death Coil is used on an enemy Hero, launch an additional Death Coil at a nearby enemy Hero.  Passive: Death Coil deals more damage the lower Arthas's current Health is, up to a maximum of 50% bonus damage.

level_thirteen.title: Shattered Armor

talentInfo.title: Crystal Aegis
talentInfo.description: Place an allied Hero into Stasis for 2 seconds. Upon expiration, Crystal Aegis deals 255 (+4% per level) damage to all nearby enemies.

talentInfo.title: Resurrect
talentInfo.description: Channel on the spirit of a dead ally for 1 second. After a 3 second delay, they are brought back to life with 100% of their maximum Health at the location where they died.  Auriel can use this ability while dead to resurrect herself.

talentInfo.title: Piercing Lash
talentInfo.description: Detainment Strike now pierces and hits all enemy Heroes in a line, reducing the cooldown by 2 seconds for each Hero hit.

talentInfo.title: Blinding Flash

talentInfo.title: Reservoir of Hope
talentInfo.description: Quest: Each maximum energy Ray of Heaven Auriel casts increases the maximum amount of energy that can be stored by 55.

talentInfo.title: Shield of Hope

talentInfo.title: Angelic Flight

Reward: After 60 stacks, gain 20 Attack Damage.  Reward: After 150 stacks, gain 50 additional Attack Damage.  Mythic Reward: After 300 stacks, gain 125 additional Attack Damage.

level_four.title: Hammer Gains
level_four.description: Basic Attacks heal for 20% of the damage dealt to the primary target.

level_seven.title: Secret Weapon
level_seven.description: Increases Hammerang's range by 30% and Basic Attacks deal 75% bonus damage while Hammerang is in flight.

level_ten.title: Mighty Gust
level_ten.description: Push enemies away, and Slow them by 40%, decaying over 4 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Sustained Winds
level_thirteen.description: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes deal bonus damage equal to 1.5% of the Hero's maximum Health, increased to 2% while Tailwind is active.

level_sixteen.title: Afterburner
level_sixteen.description: Barrel Roll increases Movement Speed by 60%, decaying over 3 seconds.

level_twenty.title: Wind Tunnel
level_twenty.description: Mighty Gust creates a wind tunnel for 4 seconds. Enemies caught in the tunnel will periodically be pushed back.

talentInfo.title: Arsenal Synergy
talentInfo.description: After hitting enemy Heroes with Basic Attacks 3 times while Repeater Cannon is active, the next Basic Attack with Phase Bomb deals 150% more damage and splashes in a 50% larger area.

talentInfo.title: Target Acquired
talentInfo.description: Basic Attacks against Slowed Heroes with Repeater Cannon active grant 10% Movement Speed for 4 seconds, up to 40%.

talentInfo.title: Combat Advantage
talentInfo.description: Plasma Cutter deals 35% more damage to Slowed targets.

talentInfo.title: Purification Salvo
talentInfo.description: Channel for 1.5 seconds, sweeping a laser in front of Fenix that locks onto enemy Heroes. Once Channeling finishes, fire 5 missiles at each locked Hero, dealing 79 (+4% per level) damage each. Deals 50% increased damage to Slowed targets.

talentInfo.title: Auxiliary Shields
talentInfo.description: Permanently reduce Fenix's maximum Health by 30% but increase Shield Capacitor's Shield by 40%. Basic Attacks regenerate Shields equal to 10% of the damage dealt.

talentInfo.title: Rapid Recharge
talentInfo.description: The time before Shield Capacitor begins regenerating after taking damage is reduced by 2 seconds. Whenever Fenix is healed, Shield Capacitor's Shield recharges for 60% of the healing received.

talentInfo.title: Photonic Weaponry
talentInfo.description: Fenix deals 20% more damage while he has a Shield from Shield Capacitor.

talentInfo.title: Secondary Fire
talentInfo.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Plasma Cutter fires a Purification Salvo missile at them after 0.5 seconds, dealing 79 (+4% per level) damage. Deals 50% increased damage to Slowed targets.

talentInfo.title: Rising Dread
talentInfo.description: Each bounce of Dread Orb increases its radius by 20% and damage by 15%. Activate Dread Orb before the second bounce ends to reverse the direction of the third bounce.

talentInfo.title: Ogre Rampage
talentInfo.description: Increase the damage bonus of Ogre Rage by 5%. Each time Gall damages an enemy Hero while Ogre Rage is active, this bonus increases by 1% for 4 seconds, up to an additional 10% bonus damage.

talentInfo.title: Shadow Bolt Volley
talentInfo.description: After 1 second, unleash 20 Shadow Bolts over 4 seconds, each dealing 87 (+4% per level) damage to the first target hit. The bolts fire towards your mouse.

talentInfo.title: Twisting Nether
talentInfo.description: After 1 second, nearby enemies are Slowed by 50% while Gall channels, up to 5 seconds. Activate to deal 353 (+5% per level) damage.

talentInfo.title: Twilight Nova
talentInfo.description: After the first bounce of Dread Orb, 2 extra bombs bounce to the sides once.

talentInfo.title: Deafening Blast
talentInfo.description: Runic Blast Silences enemy Heroes for 1.25 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Shadowfury
talentInfo.description: Shadow Bolt Volley hits all enemies in its path.

talentInfo.description: Activate to throw a nearby ally and grant them 25 Armor for 3 seconds. Deals 91 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies upon impact and Slows them by 30% for 2.5 seconds.  While in flight, allied Heroes are Unstoppable.

talentInfo.title: Rough Landing
talentInfo.description: Increase Groundbreaker's Slow amount by 10% and duration by 1 second.

talentInfo.title: Warbreaker
talentInfo.description: Quest: Stun Heroes with Groundbreaker.  Reward: After Stunning 5 Heroes, Groundbreaker's Stun deals an additional 165 (+4% per level) damage over 3 seconds to Heroes.  Reward: After Stunning 15 Heroes, permanently reduce Groundbreaker's cooldown by 2 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Body Check
talentInfo.description: Activate to deal 111 (+4% per level) damage to a target enemy and Slow them by 35% for 3 seconds. Enemy Heroes hit receive 30% reduced healing for 3 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Unrivaled Strength
talentInfo.description: Increase Wrecking Ball's throw range by 15% and its damage by 75%.

talentInfo.title: Indomitable
talentInfo.description: Activate to become Unstoppable for 1.5 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Intimidation
talentInfo.description: Groundbreaker reduces the Attack Speed of Heroes hit by 30% for 4 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Oppressor
talentInfo.description: Basic Attacks and Bloodthirst against Heroes reduce the target's Spell Power by 25% for 2.5 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Warlord's Challenge
talentInfo.description: Silence nearby Heroes and force them to attack Garrosh for 2 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Decimate
talentInfo.description: Deal 50 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies and Slow them by 40% for 1.5 seconds. Deals 100% more damage to Heroes, and each Hero hit reduces the cooldown by 1 second.  Stores up to 3 charges.

talentInfo.title: Double Up
talentInfo.description: Armor Up can be activated to increase its Armor bonus by 100% for 5 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Defensive Measures
talentInfo.description: If Groundbreaker Stuns a Hero, Garrosh gains a 350 (+4% per level) Shield for 6 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Bloodcraze
talentInfo.description: When hitting a Hero, Bloodthirst heals for an additional 15% of Garrosh's maximum Health over 4 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Mortal Combo
talentInfo.description: Hitting a Hero with Groundbreaker's Stun and throwing them with Wrecking Ball within 3 seconds reduces Wrecking Ball's cooldown by 10 seconds, regardless of order.

talentInfo.title: Seasoned Soldier
talentInfo.description: Gain 5% maximum Health, increase Groundbreaker's Slow duration by 1 second, and Bloodthirst gains an additional charge.

talentInfo.title: Earthshaker
talentInfo.description: Wrecking Ball Stuns enemies near the impact area for 0.5 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Death Wish

talentInfo.title: Inner Rage
talentInfo.description: Body Check gains an additional charge and its healing reduction is increased by an additional 45%.

talentInfo.title: Titanic Might
talentInfo.description: Wrecking Ball now throws the 2 closest enemies.

talentInfo.title: Deadly Calm
talentInfo.description: Heroes hit by Decimate deal 40% less damage for 3 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Echoed Corruption
talentInfo.description: Quest: Hit enemy Heroes with Corruption.  Reward: After hitting 40 heroes, Corruption gains new functionality. After the third strike, Corruption strikes 3 times in the opposite direction.  Mythic Reward: After 85 hits, Corruption heals for 100% of the damage dealt.

talentInfo.title: Pursuit of Flame
talentInfo.description: Quest: Hit 30 enemy Heroes with Fel Flame without dying.  Reward: Permanently increase Fel Flame's area by 33%.

talentInfo.title: Chaotic Energy
talentInfo.description: Increases the cast range of Drain Life by 25%, and Regen Globes heal for 50% more.  Quest: Gather 15 Regen Globes.  Reward: Basic Ability Mana costs are permanently reduced by 20.

talentInfo.title: Consume Soul
talentInfo.description: Instantly kill an enemy Minion and heal for 365 (+4% per level) Health.  Stores up to 3 charges.

talentInfo.title: Health Funnel
talentInfo.description: Drain Life's cooldown recharges 100% faster while it is channeling. If an enemy dies while under the effect of Drain Life, the cooldown is instantly refreshed.

talentInfo.title: Hunger for Power
talentInfo.description: Increases Spell Power by 15% but reduces healing received from allies by 25%.

talentInfo.title: Bound by Shadow
talentInfo.description: Each enemy Hero hit with Fel Flame reduces the cooldown of Corruption by 1.75 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Curse of Exhaustion
talentInfo.description: Drain Life deals 50% more damage and Slows the target's Movement Speed by 40%.

talentInfo.title: Horrify
talentInfo.description: After 0.5 seconds, deal 120 (+4% per level) damage to enemy Heroes in an area and Fear them for 2 seconds. While Feared, Heroes are Silenced and are forced to run away from Horrify's center.

talentInfo.title: Healthstone
talentInfo.description: Activate to heal for 25% of Gul'dan's maximum Health.

talentInfo.title: Fel Armor
talentInfo.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Fel Flame grants 50 Spell Armor for 2.5 seconds, reducing Ability Damage taken by 50%.

talentInfo.title: Harvest Life
talentInfo.description: Drain Life heals for 75% more Health when used on Heroes.

talentInfo.title: Ruinous Affliction
talentInfo.description: Corruption deals an additional 70 (+4% per level) damage on impact. If the enemy is hit by all three strikes, the third strike deals 242 (+4% per level) damage.

talentInfo.title: Rampant Hellfire
talentInfo.description: Fel Flame's damage is increased by 12% for 5 seconds when hitting an enemy Hero. This can stack up to 5 times.

talentInfo.title: Darkness Within
talentInfo.description: Dealing 600 (+4% per level) damage to enemy Heroes causes the next cast of Life Tap to cost no Health and grant Gul'dan 25% Spell Power for 5 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Haunt
talentInfo.description: Increases the duration of Horrify by 1 second, and while Feared, enemies lose 20 Armor, causing them to take 20% increased damage.

talentInfo.title: Simple Geometry
talentInfo.description: Quest: Hit a Hero with multiple arrows from the same Scatter Arrow cast 20 times. Each arrow hit after the second grants additional progress.  Reward: Upon hitting terrain for the first time, Scatter Arrow creates 2 additional arrows.

talentInfo.title: Redemption
talentInfo.description: Quest: Every 2 Basic Attacks against the same Hero within 10 seconds grants 1 Redemption, stacking up to 12. Dying decreases Redemption by 3, and Redemption can be lost even at maximum stacks.  Reward: At 12 Redemption, gain 50% Attack Speed.

talentInfo.title: Target Practice
talentInfo.description: Quest: Hit every enemy Hero with Storm Bow.  Reward: After hitting every enemy Hero once with Storm Bow, its range is increased by 30%.  Reward: After hitting every enemy Hero 3 times with Storm Bow, its damage is increased by 100.

talentInfo.title: Explosive Arrows
talentInfo.description: Upon hitting a Minion or Monster, Storm Bow deals 60% of its damage to enemies around its target.

talentInfo.title: Serrated Arrows
talentInfo.description: Scatter Arrow deals 100% more damage to Minions, Mercenaries, and Monsters.

talentInfo.title: Ignore All Distractions
talentInfo.description: Basic Attacks instantly kill Minions and increase Hanzo's Basic Attack range by 2 for 3 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Never Outmatched
talentInfo.description: Reduce Scatter Arrow's Mana cost from 50 to 30. Basic Attacks against Heroes lower the cooldown of Scatter Arrow by 3 seconds.

talentInfo.title: The Dragon Hungers
talentInfo.description: Hitting a Hero with Storm Bow grants 5% Spell Power for 12 seconds, stacking up to 20%.

talentInfo.title: Dragon's Arrow
talentInfo.description: Fire a missile that travels across the battleground. Explodes upon hitting an enemy Hero, dealing 130 (+4% per level) damage to all nearby enemies and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds.  After traveling a medium distance, the damage is increased to 260 (+4% per level) and the Stun duration to 1.25 seconds.  After traveling a long distance, the damage is increased to 390 (+4% per level) and the Stun duration to 2 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Dragonstrike
talentInfo.description: After 1.5 seconds, summon a pair of Spirit Dragons which travel forward, dealing 84 (+4% per level) damage every 0.25 seconds to enemy Heroes in its area. Enemies in the center take 75% increased damage.

talentInfo.title: Ninja Assassin
talentInfo.description: Hitting Heroes with Storm Bow lowers Natural Agility's cooldown by 10 seconds. Additionally, Hero Takedowns reset Natural Agility's cooldown.

talentInfo.title: Fleet of Foot
talentInfo.description: Hitting a Hero with Storm Bow grants 10% Movement Speed for 6 seconds, up to 30%.

talentInfo.title: Piercing Arrows
talentInfo.description: Storm Bow and Scatter Arrow pierce, hitting an additional enemy. Additionally, Scatter Arrow can pierce through 1 enemy each time it ricochets.

talentInfo.title: Giant Slayer
talentInfo.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Scatter Arrow and Basic Attacks take a bonus 1.6% of their maximum Health as damage.

talentInfo.title: Flawless Technique
talentInfo.description: Hitting Heroes with Storm Bow increases the damage of Hanzo's next Basic Attack within 5 seconds by 40%. Basic Attacks against Heroes increase the damage of Hanzo's next Storm Bow within 5 seconds by 40%.

talentInfo.title: Play of the Game
talentInfo.description: While in flight or for up to 2 seconds after impacting a target, Dragon's Arrow can be reactivated to teleport to its location and jump backwards. If used after impact, Hanzo shoots arrows that deal 132 (+4% per level) damage to each target hit by the impact.  Hanzo is Unstoppable during Play of the Game.

talentInfo.title: Perfect Agility
talentInfo.description: Natural Agility gains a 2nd charge and its cooldown is reduced by 10 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Bullseye
talentInfo.description: Increase Sonic Arrow's speed and center radius by 100%. Additionally, Heroes hit by Sonic Arrow's center are Stunned for 1 second.

level_thirteen.description: Hitting Heroes with Storm Bow lowers Natural Agility's cooldown by 10 seconds. Additionally, Hero Takedowns reset Natural Agility's cooldown.

level_sixteen.title: Giant Slayer
level_sixteen.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Scatter Arrow and Basic Attacks take a bonus 1.6% of their maximum Health as damage.

level_twenty.title: Bullseye
level_twenty.description: Increase Sonic Arrow's speed and center radius by 100%. Additionally, Heroes hit by Sonic Arrow's center are Stunned for 1 second.

level_one.title: Simple Geometry
level_one.description: Quest: Hit a Hero with multiple arrows from the same Scatter Arrow cast 20 times. Each arrow hit after the second grants additional progress.  Reward: Upon hitting terrain for the first time, Scatter Arrow creates 2 additional arrows.

level_four.title: Explosive Arrows
level_four.description: Upon hitting a Minion or Monster, Storm Bow deals 60% of its damage to enemies around its target.

level_seven.title: Never Outmatched
level_seven.description: Reduce Scatter Arrow's Mana cost from 50 to 30. Basic Attacks against Heroes lower the cooldown of Scatter Arrow by 3 seconds.

level_ten.title: Dragon's Arrow
level_ten.description: Fire a missile that travels across the battleground. Explodes upon hitting an enemy Hero, dealing 130 (+4% per level) damage to all nearby enemies and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds.  After traveling a medium distance, the damage is increased to 260 (+4% per level) and the Stun duration to 1.25 seconds.  After traveling a long distance, the damage is increased to 390 (+4% per level) and the Stun duration to 2 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Fleet of Foot
level_thirteen.description: Hitting a Hero with Storm Bow grants 10% Movement Speed for 6 seconds, up to 30%.

level_sixteen.title: Piercing Arrows
level_sixteen.description: Storm Bow and Scatter Arrow pierce, hitting an additional enemy. Additionally, Scatter Arrow can pierce through 1 enemy each time it ricochets.

level_twenty.title: Play of the Game
level_twenty.description: While in flight or for up to 2 seconds after impacting a target, Dragon's Arrow can be reactivated to teleport to its location and jump backwards. If used after impact, Hanzo shoots arrows that deal 132 (+4% per level) damage to each target hit by the impact.  Hanzo is Unstoppable during Play of the Game.

talentInfo.description: Activate to gain 25 Rage over 8 seconds.  Passive: You heal for 7 (+4% per level) Health every second, increased by 2% per point of Rage.

talentInfo.description: Consuming a Valorous Brand mark deals bonus damage equal to 2.5% of the Hero's maximum Health.

talentInfo.title: Impaling Light
talentInfo.description: Celestial Charge deals 150% more damage to Heroes, reduced by 25% for each additional Hero hit. For each Valorous Brand on the target when Celestial Charge's Stun completes, reduce its cooldown by 1 second.  Passive: Reduce Celestial Charge's cooldown by 1.5 seconds, and its Mana cost from 40 to 30.

talentInfo.title: Sovereign Armor
talentInfo.description: Molten Armor grants 20 Armor for 1.5 seconds. Hitting an enemy Hero with Molten Armor extends the duration of this Armor by 0.5 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Battle Hunger
talentInfo.description: Increase the healing of Valorous Brand by 80%.

talentInfo.title: Press Forward
talentInfo.description: Gain 10 Armor while being healed by a Regeneration Globe. Damaging an enemy Hero sets the duration of an active Regeneration Globe on Imperius to 8 seconds (unless it is already higher).

talentInfo.title: Holy Fervor
talentInfo.description: Activate to reset Imperius's Basic Attack cooldown and cause the next 4 Basic Attacks within 10 seconds to cleave for 30% additional damage.

talentInfo.title: Flash of Anger
talentInfo.description: Consuming a mark from Celestial Charge deals 150 (+4% per level) damage to the target and nearby enemies and grants Imperius a 250 (+4% per level) point Shield for 4 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Angelic Armaments
talentInfo.description: Summon a ring of blazing swords that grants 850 (+4% per level) Shield for 3 seconds.  If the Shield lasts the full duration, this ability can be reactivated within 5 seconds to launch 6 swords toward an area, each dealing 140 (+4% per level) damage to the first enemy hit.

talentInfo.title: Wrath of the Angiris
talentInfo.description: After 0.75 seconds, charge in the target direction, lifting the first enemy Hero hit into the Heavens. While in the air, Imperius can steer the landing location by moving.  After 2 seconds, slam the target into the ground, dealing 250 (+4% per level) damage to them, increased by 20% for each Valorous Brand on the target when landing, and Stunning them for 1 second.

talentInfo.title: Divine Rage
talentInfo.description: Consuming a Valorous Brand mark reduces the cooldown of Molten Armor by 1 second.

talentInfo.title: Pathetic Mortals
talentInfo.description: Stunning enemy Heroes with Celestial Charge reduces their Movement Speed by 25% and their damage by 50% for 4 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Melting Touch
talentInfo.description: Consuming a Molten Armor mark reduces the target's Armor by 25 for 4 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Celestial Swiftness
talentInfo.description: Gain 20% Movement Speed for 5 seconds after casting Celestial Charge. Gain 40% Attack Speed for 5 seconds for each Hero Stunned with Celestial Charge.

talentInfo.title: Heavenly Host
talentInfo.description: Shields granted by Angelic Armaments no longer expire, and on initial activation, nearby allied Heroes gain a Shield that absorbs 600 (+4% per level) damage. talentInfo.title: Sticky Wicket
talentInfo.description: Enemy Heroes who are hit by Steel Trap are Silenced for 2 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Bogged Down
talentInfo.description: Enemies launched by Concussion Mine are Slowed by 40% for 2.5 seconds upon landing.

talentInfo.title: RIP-Tire
talentInfo.description: Create a motorized bomb with 530 (+4% per level) Health that lasts 15 seconds. While active, Junkrat is immobile but gains control of RIP-Tire's movement. talentInfo.description: Increase the range of Drain Hope by 25%.

talentInfo.title: Entomb

talentInfo.title: Crushing Hope

talentInfo.title: Ice Storm
talentInfo.description: Every 3rd hit of Blizzard against enemy Heroes deals an additional 42 (+4% per level) damage. Blizzard's final Stun damage is increased by 150% against all enemies.

talentInfo.title: Heat Transfer
talentInfo.description: Basic Attacks against Stunned, Rooted, or Slowed Heroes deal 33% more damage. Each time Mei Stuns or Slows an enemy Hero she heals for 16 (+4% per level) Health.

talentInfo.title: Cold Front
talentInfo.description: Reduce the cooldown of Icing by 3 seconds. If Mei enters her own Blizzard while Icing is active, the cooldown of Icing is reduced by 5 seconds and she gains 80 Mana.

talentInfo.title: Crystallize
talentInfo.description: Reduce the cooldown of Cryo-Freeze by 10 seconds. Mei gains 40 Spell Armor while Cryo-Freeze is active and for 1 second after.

talentInfo.title: Skating Away
talentInfo.description: When Icing ends, Mei and all nearby allied Heroes gain 20% Movement Speed and 50 Physical Armor for 3 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Induce Hibernation
talentInfo.description: Blizzard reduces the damage dealt by enemy Heroes inside of its area by 40%.  When Blizzard ends, enemy Heroes still within its area gain this effect for an additional 4 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Avalanche
talentInfo.description: After 0.5 seconds, roll a massive snowball that consumes enemy Heroes in its path. At the end of its path, the snowball crumbles, releasing the consumed Heroes, dealing 220 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds per Hero consumed.

talentInfo.title: Ice Wall
talentInfo.description: Vector Targeting After a 0.75 second delay, create an impassable wall that traps enemy Heroes hit for 2.5 seconds. When the wall expires, trapped Heroes are Slowed by 75%, decaying over 3 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Cooling Servos
talentInfo.description: While Cryo-Freeze is active, Mei's Basic Ability cooldowns recover 200% faster.  Passive: Basic Attacks Slow by 20% for 1.5 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Polar Vortex
talentInfo.description: Using an ability causes Mei to deal 24 (+4% per level) damage a second to nearby enemies for 4 seconds. Enemy Heroes damaged by this effect also have their Movement Speed and Attack Speed Slowed by 20%.

talentInfo.title: Flurry
talentInfo.description: While in her own Blizzard, Mei gains 50% increased Attack Speed and Blizzard's cooldown refreshes 125% faster. If Mei is in her own Blizzard when it ends, gain these bonuses for 3 additional seconds.

talentInfo.title: Black Ice
talentInfo.description: Icing's Slow effect no longer decays over its duration. Icing deals 300% more damage to enemies very close to Mei.

talentInfo.title: Acclimation
talentInfo.description: Each time Mei Stuns or Slows an enemy Hero, the damage she deals and healing she receives is increased by 1%, stacking up to 20 times. While at maximum stacks, Mei also gains 10 Armor. Lasts 8 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Flash Freeze
talentInfo.description: When Mei takes fatal damage she instantly gains Cryo-Freeze. This effect has a 180 second cooldown.

talentInfo.title: The Big One
talentInfo.description: Every 15 seconds, the next Snow Blind you cast has 67% increased area and 200% increased damage.

talentInfo.title: Cascade
talentInfo.description: While traveling, Avalanche constantly launches a volley of untalented Snow Blind snowballs ahead of itself.  Passive: Reduce the cooldown of Avalanche by 30 seconds.

talentInfo.description: Shade of Mephisto grants 20% Movement Speed while active and for 2.5 seconds after it ends.  If Mephisto hits enemy Heroes at least 18 times with his Basic Abilities while Shade of Mephisto is active, then reset the cooldown of Shade of Mephisto.

talentInfo.title: Durance of Hate
talentInfo.description: After 1 second, unleash a wave of evil spirits that Root the first enemy Hero hit for 2.5 seconds and deal 250 (+4% per level) damage to them over the same duration.  Durance of Hate spreads outwards from its initial target, Rooting and damaging additional nearby enemy Heroes.

talentInfo.title: Shard of Hate
talentInfo.description: Basic Attacks hit enemies near the primary target and activate Lord of Hatred against enemy Heroes, reducing Basic Ability cooldowns by 1 second per Hero hit.

talentInfo.title: Abhorred Skull

talentInfo.description: When Lightning Nova's damage bonus reaches 30%, enemy Heroes within its radius take damage equal to 10% of their maximum Health.

talentInfo.title: Mimic

talentInfo.title: Reactive Ballistospores
talentInfo.description: Activate to instantly spread a Weighted Pustule to all nearby enemy Heroes and reset the cooldown of Bio-Kill Switch.  Passive: While below 50% Health, the cooldown of Bio-Kill Switch refreshes 100% faster.

talentInfo.title: Low Blow
talentInfo.description: Lurking Arm deals 100% more damage to enemy Heroes below 50% Health and persists for 1 second after it is canceled.

talentInfo.title: One Good Spread...
talentInfo.description: After a Healing Pathogen infests 3 targets, restore 10 Mana and reduce the cooldown of Healing Pathogen by 2 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Vigorous Reuptake
talentInfo.description: Bio-Kill Switch heals for 30% more when detonating 3 or more Healing Pathogens.

talentInfo.title: Biotic Armor
talentInfo.description: Healing Pathogen grants 10 Physical Armor to targets while active on them. Detonating Bio-Kill Switch increases this bonus to 50 for 2.5 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Targeted Excision
talentInfo.description: Detonating exactly 1 Weighted Pustule (but any number of Healing Pathogens) with Bio-Kill Switch reduces the cooldown of Bio-Kill Switch to 7 seconds and other Basic Abilities by 1.5 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Growing Infestation
talentInfo.description: Lurking Arm's area expands by 50% over 2.5 seconds, but it cannot be Channeled for longer than 3 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Massive Shove
talentInfo.description: Extend Stukov's arm. If it hits an enemy Hero, they are rapidly shoved until they collide with terrain, dealing 190 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds. Stukov gains 50 Armor while shoving an enemy.

talentInfo.title: Flailing Swipe
talentInfo.description: Swipe 3 times in front of Stukov over 1.75 seconds, dealing 48 (+4% per level) damage to enemies hit and knocking them away. Each swipe is larger than the previous.

talentInfo.title: Poppin' Pustules
talentInfo.description: Detonating Weighted Pustule with Bio-Kill Switch within 1.5 seconds of its expiration increases its damage by 150% and applies its damage and Slow in an area. Enemy Heroes hit have a Weighted Pustule applied to them.

talentInfo.title: Virulent Reaction
talentInfo.description: Detonating a Weighted Pustule on an enemy who is inside of Lurking Arm Roots them for 1.5 seconds.

talentInfo.title: It Hungers
talentInfo.description: Increase the range of Lurking Arm by 30%. If Lurking Arm damages enemy Heroes 8 times, its cooldown is reset and its Mana cost is refunded.

talentInfo.title: Pox Populi
talentInfo.description: Bio-Kill Switch no longer removes Healing Pathogen but instead sets its duration to 3 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Universal Carrier
talentInfo.description: Healing Pathogen can continually spread through Stukov, but its healing is reduced by 25%.

talentInfo.title: Superstrain
talentInfo.description: Whenever an ally with Healing Pathogen is Stunned or Rooted, they are instantly healed for 300 (+4% per level) Health.

talentInfo.title: Push Comes To Shove
talentInfo.description: Massive Shove Slows its target by 50% for 4 seconds upon colliding with terrain. If Massive Shove pushes a target for more than 1.25 seconds, its cooldown is reduced by 15 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Top Off
talentInfo.description: Healing Pathogen's heal over time is increased by 30% while its target is above 60% Health.
